findings.title: The heredoc-early-termination class is mitigated, not closed: defence rests on the agent always restricting the path to a code plus [a-z0-9-] slug before assembly, enforced only by prose; a payload containing the known fixed token still bypasses the shell construct the same way EOF did, and no test exercises that payload end-to-end.
findings.consequence: The owner's ruling asked for an unguessable delimiter; a static, tracked, public string is the opposite to an adversary with repo read access.

findings.title: The path regex's series part [A-Z]+ is not anchored to PLAN|REQ, broader than ADR-019's promoted-draft population.
findings.evidence: Same files; it would also accept e.g. ADR-004-slug.md.
